definitions.explanation: The first year of school or the first grade. Often used as 一年生.

examples.japanese: {一年|いちねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十二|じゅうに}→十二：00952_juuni⟧か{月|げつ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are twelve months in a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧{一年|いちねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been one year since I came to Japan.

examples.japanese: {一年|いちねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the coldest month of the year is January.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧です。
examples.english: My son is in first grade of elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{一年|いちねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started studying Japanese in my first year of university.

notes:
{一年|いちねん} means "one year" (duration) or "first year" (ordinal).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}: all year round
- ⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧: for one year (emphasizes duration)
- ⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧: first-year student, first grader
- {一年|いちねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧: once a year

NOTE ON COUNTING YEARS:
- {一年|いちねん} (1 year)
- ⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧ (2 years)
- ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧ (3 years)
- {四年|よねん} (4 years) — not しねん
- {五年|ごねん} (5 years)
